purpose: Define structural validation that every canonical artifact conforms to Contract Format 1.4 required sections, field shapes and source-role rules before deeper semantic validation.

topics.name: Contract Format Validation
topics.purpose: Define structural validation that every canonical artifact conforms to Contract Format 1.4 required sections, field shapes and source-role rules before deeper semantic validation.

semantics.version_rule: Artifact must explicitly declare Contract Format 1.4 compatibility.
semantics.shape_rule: Required fields use the declared 1.4 data shapes.
semantics.source_role_rule: source_role must resolve through the canonical Source Role Registry.
semantics.unknown_field_rule: Unknown fields follow explicit extension policy; validator never silently treats them as semantics.
semantics.ordering_rule: Validation does not infer meaning from object key order or ordinary array position.
semantics.failure_rule: Format failure stops semantic lock eligibility but preserves machine-readable diagnostics.

invariants.rule: Validation proves or rejects conformance; it never invents missing semantics or becomes semantic owner.

hard_gates.condition: validator infers semantics from unknown field

references.purpose: Format validation respects JSON serialization non-semantics.

prose.summary: Define structural validation that every canonical artifact conforms to Contract Format 1.4 required sections, field shapes and source-role rules before deeper semantic validation.
notes: Unlocked until exercised against the complete assembled Contract Format 1.4 tree.
